purpose: smaller sample of evidence-quality-synthetic-v1 for the live sessions of U1 to U7: one authored case per category
selection: The 19 categories (the middle part of record_id "synthetic:<category>:<language>") in the order of their first appearance in records.jsonl; the 1st, 3rd, 5th ... category takes its zh case, the 2nd, 4th ... its en case (10 zh, 9 en). content_sha256 is the SHA-256 of text_original as UTF-8.
